title: Bind groups and uniforms
summary: Adds BufferUsage.uniform, Buffer.uniformSize(), BindGroup wrapper, and Draw.getBindGroupLayout() / draw(..., bindGroup?). New triangle-time example animates triangle scale via a vec4 time uniform. WGSL struct uses vec4 (16 bytes) to match minBindingSize; bind group created once per pipeline, buffer updated each frame.
